'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine (2022–present)|Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Slovakia]] announces that it will donate its [[Mikoyan MiG-29|MiG-29]] [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]]s, and supply part of its [[2K12 Kub|Kub air-defense system]] to [[Ukraine]]. *[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**The [[Taliban]] kill several [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province]] [[insurgent]]s and seize weapons and [[ammunition]]s during raids at hideouts in [[Mazar-i-Sharif]], [[Balkh Province]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230318/61fe5e9923ee4bef9becde400fece1c9/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Turkish floods]]
**The death toll from the floods in [[Şanlıurfa]] and [[Adıyaman]], [[Turkey]], increases to 18. [https://www.anews.com.tr/turkey/2023/03/17/death-toll-from-flash-floods-in-southeastern-turkiye-rises-to-18 (A News)]
*Fourteen people are killed and at least 12 others are injured by a roof collapse at a [[Cool warehouse|cold storage warehouse]] in [[Sambhal]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2023/03/17/india-14-killed-by-avalanche-of-potatoes-after-storage-roof-collapses-18462773/ (Metro)]
*Ten people are killed and three others are injured by a house fire in [[Kohistan District, Pakistan|Kohistan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-house-fire-roof-killed-52e3e5dbaea2840772546705532d26d8 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Finland–Turkey relations]]
***[[Turkish president]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] announces that Turkey will begin the process of ratifying [[Finland]]'s membership of [[NATO]] without [[Sweden]], which Turkey accuses of supporting the [[PKK]]. [https://yle.fi/a/74-20022948 (Yle)]
**[[Finland–Hungary relations]]
***[[Hungary]] announces that a vote on Finland's membership application will take place on March 27. [[Fidesz]] parliamentary group leader [[Máté Kocsis]] says that Sweden's application will be considered at a later date. [https://www.barrons.com/news/hungary-sets-march-vote-for-finland-s-nato-bid-e46c057c (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine (2022–present)|Russian invasion of Ukraine]]

***The [[International Criminal Court]] issues [[Vladimir Putin arrest warrant|an arrest warrant]] for [[Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and [[Maria Lvova-Belova]], [[Children's ombudsman#Russia|presidential commissioner for children's rights]], for alleged [[war crimes]] involving the [[Child abductions in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|abduction and forced adoption of children]] from [[Ukraine]]. *[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]]
